quests.hint: Say what you ordered, what came, and why it matters. Keep the tone calm by explaining, not blaming.
quests.explanation: The mistake matters because of a dietary need, so mentioning it ('I don't eat meat') explains the urgency. Asking for a change is more constructive than complaining.
quests.situationText: A vegetarian sandwich was on your order, but the one the waiter has just brought contains chicken. You don't eat meat, and you want to explain the mistake without sounding angry.
quests.sampleAnswer: Sorry, I ordered the vegetarian sandwich, but this has chicken in it. Could you change it, please? I don't eat meat.
quests.correctAnswer: Excuse me, I ordered the vegetarian sandwich, but this one has chicken. Could you change it, please? I don't eat meat.
acceptedSynonyms: I think there's been a mix-up. This has chicken, and I asked for the vegetarian one. Could you bring the right one?
Excuse me, I ordered the vegetarian sandwich, but this one has chicken. Could you change it, please? I don't eat meat.
Sorry to bother you, but this isn't what I ordered. I asked for vegetarian, and this contains chicken.
This sandwich has chicken in it, but I ordered the vegetarian version. Could you replace it, please?

quests.hint: For an online order, compare what you ordered and what you received. Then ask what the company can do.
quests.explanation: Stating the two facts ('black' versus 'gray') makes the error clear. 'What can we do?' invites the company to propose a solution instead of putting them on the defensive.
quests.situationText: You ordered a black jacket from an online shop, but a gray one arrived. You write to the customer service chat.
quests.sampleAnswer: My order is wrong. I chose black and got gray. Could you send me the right one?
quests.correctAnswer: I ordered a black jacket, but I received a gray one. What can we do?
acceptedSynonyms: My order is wrong. I chose black and got gray. Could you send me the right one?
The jacket that arrived is gray, but my order was for black. How can this be corrected?
I received the wrong color. I ordered a black jacket, not a gray one. What are my options?
I ordered a black jacket, but I received a gray one. What can we do?

quests.hint: List what's missing so the restaurant can fix it in one step. Being specific speeds up the refund or replacement.
quests.explanation: Listing exactly what's missing helps the restaurant see the size of the problem. Naming the items lets them check against your order and decide between a refund and a replacement.
quests.situationText: Your delivered meal arrives in a bag, but half the order is missing: no rice and no drink. You call the restaurant.
quests.sampleAnswer: Hi, my delivery is incomplete. There's no rice and no drink in the bag.
quests.correctAnswer: Half of my order is missing. There's no rice and no drink in the bag.
acceptedSynonyms: I've just received my order, but the rice and the drink aren't in it. Can you help?
Half of my order is missing. There's no rice and no drink in the bag.
My delivery is missing two items: the rice and the drink. Could you send them?
There are things missing from my order. I can't find any rice or the drink.

quests.hint: Say where you were, roughly when, and what the item looks like. Staff use this to check.
quests.explanation: Lost-and-found staff can't search without location, time, and item. Giving all three in the first sentence lets them look at once.
quests.situationText: After a film in Screen 3 ended, you left the cinema and realized on the street that you forgot your umbrella. You went back, and you're now at the ticket desk.
quests.sampleAnswer: I was watching a film in Screen 3 and left my umbrella there. Is there one in the lost property?
quests.correctAnswer: I left my umbrella in Screen 3 about an hour ago. Has anyone handed one in?
acceptedSynonyms: Excuse me, I forgot my umbrella in Screen 3 an hour ago. Has anyone found it?
I was watching a film in Screen 3 and left my umbrella there. Is there one in the lost property?
Have you had an umbrella handed in? I lost mine in Screen 3 about an hour ago.
I left my umbrella in Screen 3 about an hour ago. Has anyone handed one in?

quests.hint: Give the route, the time, and ask for the correct contact. Don't assume you know who handles it.
quests.explanation: The route number and time help the transport company narrow the search. Asking who to contact avoids being sent from department to department.
quests.situationText: You realize your wallet is missing after getting off the number 14 bus this morning. You call the transport office.
quests.sampleAnswer: I think I dropped my wallet on the number 14 bus this morning. Who should I contact?
quests.correctAnswer: Hello, I think I lost my wallet on the number 14 bus this morning. Who should I contact about it?
acceptedSynonyms: My wallet may have fallen out on the number 14 bus this morning. Where do I report that?
Hello, I think I lost my wallet on the number 14 bus this morning. Who should I contact about it?
I lost my wallet on the number 14 this morning. Can you tell me who deals with lost property?
I believe I left my wallet on bus 14 today. Could you tell me who to speak to?

quests.hint: Hand the item over with where and when you found it, then ask what will happen to it.
quests.explanation: Explaining where you found the item gives the owner a way to identify it. Asking them to 'hold it' leaves the decision on the follow-up to the staff.
quests.situationText: On a park bench, you discover a phone that isn't yours. You take it to the reception of a nearby hotel.
quests.sampleAnswer: Excuse me, I found this phone on a bench outside. Could you hold on to it in case someone comes looking?
quests.correctAnswer: I found this phone on a bench. Could you hold it in case someone comes to ask?
acceptedSynonyms: Someone left this phone on a bench near your entrance. Could you keep it safe for the owner?
I found a phone on a bench outside. Would you mind keeping it in case the owner returns?
This phone was on a bench just outside. Can you look after it until someone claims it?
I found this phone on a bench. Could you hold it in case someone comes to ask?

quests.hint: If your booking can't be found, point to your proof and ask them to search again with the details you have.
quests.explanation: Offering your confirmation email gives the restaurant something to check, which is more productive than arguing. Saying the time again helps them find the entry.
quests.situationText: You arrive at a restaurant at eight for your reservation, but the host says nothing is booked under your name. You have your confirmation email on your phone.
quests.sampleAnswer: I booked a table for eight o'clock. Could you check again? I have the confirmation email here.
quests.correctAnswer: I booked a table for eight. Can you check again? I have the confirmation email.
acceptedSynonyms: I definitely reserved a table for eight. Would you mind looking again? I have the email on my phone.
Could you double-check the system? My booking was for eight, and here's the confirmation.
I booked a table for eight. Can you check again? I have the confirmation email.
There should be a table for us at eight. I can show you my confirmation email if that helps.

quests.hint: You may say no or negotiate. Name the conditions under which you'd agree, and stay polite.
quests.explanation: You have the right to say no or negotiate. Stating conditions ('a later flight and compensation') turns a demand into a fair deal, and it stays polite.
quests.situationText: At the gate, the flight is overbooked and the agent asks if you'd give up your seat for the next flight tomorrow. You have a meeting in the evening.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'd rather not, because I have a meeting tonight. I could only do it if I got a later flight today and compensation.
quests.correctAnswer: I'd prefer to keep my seat. I could only give it up for a later flight today, with compensation.
acceptedSynonyms: I'd prefer to keep my seat. I could only give it up for a later flight today, with compensation.
I'm not keen, as I have a meeting tonight. I'd only agree if there's another flight today and some compensation.
I need to be there tonight. If you can offer a later flight today plus compensation, I might consider it.
Sorry, I can't wait until tomorrow. If there's another flight this evening and compensation, I'll think about it.

quests.hint: For a substitution you don't want, explain why and insist politely on what you booked.
quests.explanation: 'I reserved' plus the price difference states your position clearly. Offering to wait for the right car is a practical alternative to arguing.
quests.situationText: At a rental desk, the agent says the compact car you reserved isn't available and offers a bigger one at a higher price.
quests.sampleAnswer: I reserved a compact car, but you're offering a bigger one at a higher price. Could I have the car I booked?
quests.correctAnswer: I booked a compact car, but this one costs more. Could I have the car I reserved?
acceptedSynonyms: I reserved a small car at a set price. Could you give me that, or the larger car at the same price?
The car I booked was a compact one. I'm not able to pay more, so what other options do you have?
I booked a compact car, but this one costs more. Could I have the car I reserved?
I don't want to pay extra. I reserved a compact car, so could you find one for me?

quests.hint: Show that another proof exists. Mention how you paid and when.
quests.explanation: Stores can often find purchases by card number and date. Saying how you paid gives them an alternative to the receipt, which turns the problem into a task.
quests.situationText: You want to return a pair of trainers that were too small, but you've lost the receipt. You bought them last week and paid by card.
quests.sampleAnswer: I can't find my receipt. Would my card payment from last week be enough for a return?
quests.correctAnswer: I don't have my receipt, but I paid by card last week. Could you look up the purchase?
acceptedSynonyms: I've lost the receipt. I bought these last week with my card. Can you find the transaction?
There's no receipt, I'm afraid, but I used my card here last week. Could you check the system?
I can't find my receipt. Would my card payment from last week be enough for a return?
I don't have my receipt, but I paid by card last week. Could you look up the purchase?

quests.hint: For a gift, explain the situation and suggest a fair outcome such as store credit.
quests.explanation: Gifts have no receipt, so asking for store credit is a realistic and polite solution. Explaining that it doesn't fit shows an honest reason.
quests.situationText: Your aunt gave you a sweater as a gift, but it doesn't fit and there's no receipt. You go to the shop she bought it from.
quests.sampleAnswer: This was a gift and it doesn't fit. I don't have the receipt. Could I exchange it for store credit?
quests.correctAnswer: This was a gift and it doesn't fit, and I don't have a receipt. Could I get store credit instead?
acceptedSynonyms: It's a present and it's too small. There's no receipt, but could you give me credit for it?
This was a gift and it doesn't fit, and I don't have a receipt. Could I get store credit instead?
I received this as a gift, and it doesn't fit. Is there any way I could exchange it without a receipt?
My aunt bought this for me, and it's the wrong size. Could I swap it for something else?

quests.hint: If you're outside the return period, be honest about it and ask for flexibility. Explain why it's reasonable.
quests.explanation: Acknowledging the rule ('I know it's been over thirty days') shows respect. Explaining the fault appeared within a normal use period gives a reason for making an exception.
quests.situationText: A pair of headphones you bought stopped working after three weeks, but the shop's return period was thirty days and it's now forty. You go to the store.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'm past the return window, but the headphones failed early. Is there any way to get help?
quests.correctAnswer: I know it's been more than thirty days, but they stopped working after three weeks. Is there anything you can do?
acceptedSynonyms: I realize the return period has passed, but the fault appeared after only three weeks. Could you make an exception?
These broke after three weeks, though I know I'm past the thirty days. What are my options?
I'm past the return window, but the headphones failed early. Is there any way to get help?
I know it's been more than thirty days, but they stopped working after three weeks. Is there anything you can do?

quests.hint: State the item, the fault, and the timing. Ask for a specific outcome right away.
quests.explanation: 'After a week' tells the shop the product failed too soon. Asking for a replacement directly saves time compared with a general complaint.
quests.situationText: You bought a blender that stopped working after one week. You have the receipt with you at the customer service desk.
quests.sampleAnswer: This blender broke after seven days. Could you replace it, please?
quests.correctAnswer: This blender stopped working after a week. I'd like a replacement, please.
acceptedSynonyms: The blender I bought last week has stopped working. Could I exchange it for a new one?
This blender broke after seven days. Could you replace it, please?
This blender stopped working after a week. I'd like a replacement, please.
I need to return this blender. It only lasted a week. I'd like a new one.

quests.hint: Point to the difference between the listing and the product, then say clearly what you want done.
quests.explanation: Comparing what was advertised with what arrived is a strong basis for an exchange. Being calm and specific ('leather versus plastic') keeps the discussion factual.
quests.situationText: The online picture showed a leather phone case, but the one delivered feels like cheap plastic. You return to the shop.
quests.sampleAnswer: The picture showed a leather case, but this feels like plastic. I'd like to exchange it.
quests.correctAnswer: The photo showed a leather case, but this is plastic. I'd like to exchange it.
acceptedSynonyms: The photo showed a leather case, but this is plastic. I'd like to exchange it.
The product isn't as described. The listing said leather, and this is plastic. Can I swap it?
This case doesn't look like the online picture. It's plastic, not leather. Could I return it?
I expected leather, as shown on your website, but this is plastic. I'd like an exchange.

quests.hint: If something is missing from the box, say so and offer a choice of solutions. Flexibility helps.
quests.explanation: Offering two options ('send a charger or replace the set') lets the shop select the cheaper one, which makes them more likely to agree.
quests.situationText: You open a new tablet at home and find the box has no charger. You call the shop that sold it.
quests.sampleAnswer: The box didn't include the charger. Could I get one, or exchange the whole set?
quests.correctAnswer: The box didn't have a charger in it. Could you send me one, or replace the whole set?
acceptedSynonyms: There's no charger in the box. Could I collect one, or swap the entire package?
I bought a tablet, but the charger isn't included. What can you do about that?
The box didn't have a charger in it. Could you send me one, or replace the whole set?
My new tablet arrived without a charger. Could you provide one or exchange the whole thing?

quests.hint: State the promise that was made, the current time, and ask for information. It keeps the conversation factual.
quests.explanation: Quoting the agreed time window ('between nine and twelve') makes the problem objective. Asking 'where is he?' is a practical question the company can answer.
quests.situationText: A technician promised to visit your flat between nine and twelve to repair the boiler. It's now one o'clock and nobody has come.
quests.sampleAnswer: Nobody has come for the boiler repair, and the window ended at twelve. What's going on?
quests.correctAnswer: You said someone would come between nine and twelve, and it's now one o'clock. Could you tell me where he is?
acceptedSynonyms: You said someone would come between nine and twelve, and it's now one o'clock. Could you tell me where he is?
I've been waiting all morning. The technician was due between nine and twelve. Do you know what happened?
Your engineer was meant to arrive before twelve. It's one o'clock. Can you find out where he is?
Nobody has come for the boiler repair, and the window ended at twelve. What's going on?

quests.hint: If a repair fails, mention the short time and ask for a free return visit. It's fair and clear.
quests.explanation: Pointing out the time since the repair ('two days') shows the fault is related to the earlier work. Asking for no charge is reasonable because the job wasn't done properly.
quests.situationText: Your washing machine was repaired on Monday, but on Wednesday it stopped again with the same error. You call the repair company.
quests.sampleAnswer: The washing machine broke again two days after the repair. Could someone come back at no charge?
quests.correctAnswer: The washing machine broke again two days after the repair. I'd like someone to come back at no charge.
acceptedSynonyms: The same fault has returned only two days after your visit. Can you send someone at no extra cost?
It's stopped again, just two days after it was fixed. Would you come back and repair it for free?
The washing machine broke again two days after the repair. I'd like someone to come back at no charge.
The repair didn't last. Two days later, the machine has the same problem. Could you fix it without charging me?

quests.hint: Point out the problem while there's still a chance to fix it. Ask for a remedy, not an apology.
quests.explanation: Speaking up during the service is much more effective than complaining after you leave. 'Is there anything you can do?' invites a fix and keeps a good relationship.
quests.situationText: Halfway through your haircut, you see it's much shorter on one side than you asked. The hairdresser is still cutting.
quests.sampleAnswer: Excuse me, this side is much shorter than I wanted. Could you match the other side?
quests.correctAnswer: That's shorter than I asked for. Is there anything you can do to even it out?
acceptedSynonyms: That's shorter than I asked for. Is there anything you can do to even it out?
Excuse me, this side is much shorter than I wanted. Could you match the other side?
I'm afraid this is shorter than I asked. Can you fix it so both sides look the same?
I asked for less off than this. Is there a way to balance it out?

quests.hint: Ask for a definite time, not a general apology. 'Exactly when' pushes for a real answer.
quests.explanation: 'Can you tell me exactly when…' asks the company to commit. Vague answers such as 'soon' don't help you plan your day.
quests.situationText: A sofa you ordered was due on Monday, and it's now Wednesday. The store's website says 'in transit'. You call customer service.
quests.sampleAnswer: My sofa was supposed to come on Monday. Could you give me a precise delivery date?
quests.correctAnswer: My order is two days late. Can you tell me exactly when it will arrive?
acceptedSynonyms: My sofa was supposed to come on Monday. Could you give me a precise delivery date?
My order is two days late. Can you tell me exactly when it will arrive?
It's already two days past the delivery date. When exactly can I expect it?
The delivery is late. Could you give me a specific day and time for its arrival?

quests.hint: A promised date has slipped, so ask for a 'realistic' new one. That word makes the builder think before he answers.
quests.explanation: Acknowledging that delays are possible ('it looks like') keeps things civil. Asking for a 'realistic' date makes them commit to a date they can meet.
quests.situationText: A builder promised your kitchen renovation would finish on Friday, but you can see there's still a lot to do. You talk to him on site.
quests.sampleAnswer: I don't think you'll finish by Friday. Can you tell me when it will really be ready?
quests.correctAnswer: The work was meant to be finished on Friday, but it looks like it will take longer. Could you give me a realistic new date?
acceptedSynonyms: I don't think you'll finish by Friday. Can you tell me when it will really be ready?
It looks as if the job will run over. What date can you honestly promise?
Friday seems unlikely now. Could we agree on a date that you can keep?
The work was meant to be finished on Friday, but it looks like it will take longer. Could you give me a realistic new date?

quests.hint: In a restaurant, ask for an update in a way that doesn't blame the waiter. State the wait first.
quests.explanation: Mentioning the wait ('forty minutes') gives a neutral fact. Asking the waiter to 'check' presents him as an ally who can help rather than an enemy.
quests.situationText: In a busy restaurant, your table has been waiting forty minutes for the main course, while the table beside yours, who arrived later, is already eating.
quests.sampleAnswer: Excuse me, we've been waiting forty minutes for our food. Could you check what's happening with our order?
quests.correctAnswer: We've been waiting forty minutes for our food. Could you check on our order, please?
acceptedSynonyms: Sorry to bother you, but our food hasn't arrived after forty minutes. Could you find out what's going on?
We've been waiting forty minutes for our food. Could you check on our order, please?
Our main courses still haven't come. Could you see whether the kitchen has our order?
We ordered forty minutes ago and we haven't been served. Would you mind checking?

quests.hint: If a plan changes and you can't adapt, state the change and ask for the right consequence. A refund is usually reasonable.
quests.explanation: Naming the cause of your problem (the new date) makes your refund request logical. Companies often allow refunds when the event changes significantly.
quests.situationText: You bought tickets for a Saturday concert, but the organizers moved it to Sunday. You have a flight home on Sunday morning.
quests.sampleAnswer: I heard the concert has been moved to Sunday. I can't come on that day. Can I get a refund?
quests.correctAnswer: I heard the concert has been moved to Sunday, and I can't go then. Can I get a refund?
acceptedSynonyms: The concert date has been changed to Sunday, but I can't make it. Would it be possible to have my money back?
I bought a ticket for Saturday, and now it's Sunday. Since I can't attend, could I get a refund?
With the concert now on Sunday, I won't be able to come. What are my options for a refund?
I heard the concert has been moved to Sunday, and I can't go then. Can I get a refund?

quests.hint: Express your disappointment briefly, then ask for a substitute. It turns a bad situation into a plan.
quests.explanation: Sharing the effort you made ('we came all this way') explains your feelings. Then asking for a similar alternative shows you're solution-focused.
quests.situationText: You traveled two hours to visit a castle, but it's closed today for repairs. You go to the tourist information office nearby.
quests.sampleAnswer: We were expecting to visit the castle, but it's closed. Could you suggest another place like it?
quests.correctAnswer: We came all this way and the castle is closed today. Is there something similar nearby that you'd recommend?
acceptedSynonyms: The castle is shut, and we traveled a long way. What else is worth seeing around here?
We came all this way and the castle is closed today. Is there something similar nearby that you'd recommend?
We were expecting to visit the castle, but it's closed. Could you suggest another place like it?
That's disappointing. We came especially for the castle. Is there another historic site close by?

quests.hint: Compare what was promised with what changed and ask for both an explanation and a replacement.
quests.explanation: Two questions ('why' and 'what instead') make the response specific. Referring to the original promise shows that you're seeking fairness, not merely complaining.
quests.situationText: Your city tour was advertised with a visit to the museum, but at the start the guide says the museum isn't included. You ask the guide.
quests.sampleAnswer: We were told the tour would include the museum. Why has it been removed, and what are we getting instead?
quests.correctAnswer: We were told the tour would include the museum. Why was that changed, and what will we see instead?
acceptedSynonyms: The museum was part of the tour when I booked. Could you explain why it's not included, and what replaces it?
I booked because of the museum visit. Why has it been dropped, and what's the alternative?
The description promised a museum visit. What happened, and what are we doing instead?
We were told the tour would include the museum. Why was that changed, and what will we see instead?

quests.hint: Describe the situation and the restriction, then ask for suggestions. Constraints like 'indoors' guide the recommendations.
quests.explanation: Giving the constraint first (rain) means the advice can fit your day. Asking 'what do you suggest' invites more than a single place.
quests.situationText: It's pouring rain in a new city, and you and your partner have a free day. You ask the tourist office worker what to do.
quests.sampleAnswer: With this rain, what are the best indoor things to do around here?
quests.correctAnswer: It's raining all day. What do you suggest we do that's indoors?
acceptedSynonyms: The weather's terrible. Can you recommend anything to do inside?
With this rain, what are the best indoor things to do around here?
It's raining all day. What do you suggest we do that's indoors?
We're stuck with rain all day. Do you have suggestions for indoor activities?

quests.hint: Ask about a transport pass by giving your length of stay and what you need it to cover.
quests.explanation: Tourist passes depend on the number of days and types of transport. Giving both details helps staff recommend the right option instead of a general list.
quests.situationText: You'll be in a city for three days and plan to use both the bus and the metro a lot. You want to know if a pass would be cheaper than single tickets.
quests.sampleAnswer: Do you have a three-day ticket that works on the buses as well as the metro?
quests.correctAnswer: We'll be here for three days. Is there a travel pass that covers the buses and the metro?
acceptedSynonyms: We'll be here for three days. Is there a travel pass that covers the buses and the metro?
We're staying three days and will use buses and the metro a lot. Is there a pass that would save us money?
Do you have a three-day ticket that works on the buses as well as the metro?
We need transport for three days. Is a combined pass available for the bus and the metro?

quests.hint: Ask for a recommendation with a preference and an exclusion. Balanced requests get better answers.
quests.explanation: Saying what you want ('traditional food') and what you don't ('too touristy') makes the local's job easier and the advice more useful.
quests.situationText: You're at a hotel reception in a small city and want to eat local food, but you're tired of tourist restaurants with photo menus.
quests.sampleAnswer: Do you know a place with proper local cooking? We'd like to avoid the tourist restaurants.
quests.correctAnswer: Where could we try traditional food, but not somewhere too touristy?
acceptedSynonyms: Could you recommend a place with local food where the locals go, not a tourist trap?
We'd love to try authentic local dishes. Do you know a place that isn't too touristy?
Where could we try traditional food, but not somewhere too touristy?
Where do local people go for traditional food? We'd prefer to avoid the tourist spots.

quests.hint: State that you understand their situation, then firmly explain yours and ask for a specific solution.
quests.explanation: Beginning with 'I understand' lowers the tension, and 'but' introduces your priorities. Requesting both a room and cost coverage is clear, reasonable, and specific.
quests.situationText: You arrive at midnight after a long journey. The hotel says it has overbooked and gives your room away, even though your booking is confirmed. The receptionist looks apologetic.
quests.sampleAnswer: I understand the hotel is full, but I have a confirmed booking, and I've been traveling all day. Could you find me a room nearby and cover the cost?
quests.correctAnswer: I understand the hotel is full, but I have a confirmed booking. Could you find me a room nearby and cover the cost?
acceptedSynonyms: I know it's not your personal fault, but my booking was confirmed. Could you arrange another hotel for tonight at your expense?
This is quite a problem, since I've traveled all day with a confirmed reservation. What can you do to find me another room?
I do have a confirmed reservation, so could you place me in a nearby hotel and pay for it?
I understand the hotel is full, but I have a confirmed booking. Could you find me a room nearby and cover the cost?

quests.hint: Two requests, one clear reason: a full refund and help finding somewhere else to stay.
quests.explanation: A last-minute cancellation is the company's or host's responsibility. Asking for a refund and help with a replacement covers both your money and your practical need.
quests.situationText: You've arrived in a town for a wedding weekend. The host of your rented apartment texts that he has to cancel your stay tonight. You call the platform's support line.
quests.sampleAnswer: My host has cancelled my stay tonight, at the last minute. Could I have a full refund, and can you help me find another place?
quests.correctAnswer: The host cancelled my booking for tonight at the last minute. Could you give me a full refund and help me find another place to stay?
acceptedSynonyms: I've just been told my apartment booking for tonight is cancelled. I'd like a refund and some help finding a similar place.
The host cancelled my booking for tonight at the last minute. Could you give me a full refund and help me find another place to stay?
My stay has been cancelled by the host, and I'm already in town. Can you refund me and find me alternative accommodation?
The host cancelled on me today. Could you refund the full amount and suggest somewhere else for tonight?

quests.hint: Explain the chain of events briefly and ask exactly what you need. Multiple problems need a clear priority.
quests.explanation: When several things went wrong, focus on the decision that matters most. Asking whether the same ticket is valid gets to the practical point quickly, without a long story.
quests.situationText: Your taxi arrived late, so you missed your train by two minutes. You're now at the ticket office with a non-refundable ticket.
quests.sampleAnswer: I missed my train because my taxi was late. Can I use the same ticket for the next train, or do I need to buy a new one?
quests.correctAnswer: I missed my train because of a taxi delay. Can I use the same ticket on the next train, or do I need a new one?
acceptedSynonyms: My taxi was late, so I missed my train by two minutes. Is my ticket still valid on the next one?
I've just missed my train. Could I take the next service with this ticket, or must I pay again?
Because of a late taxi, I missed my train. Will you allow me to use this ticket on the next departure?
I missed my train because of a taxi delay. Can I use the same ticket on the next train, or do I need a new one?
